slides.title: How feedback became application changes
slides.subtitle: Feedback and revised scripts informed changes in the dev branch, 25 August–3 September 2026.
rows:
Queued delivery with a 6 s default
between consecutive messages.

Messages arrive in a paced
sequence, not one burst.

Protect personal information
without derailing the activity

Redact detected personal details;
continue with a brief privacy note.

The question continues after
detected details are removed.

Offer review and a clear exit
(revised Week 6 scripts)

Review another topic, BUILD or
CONTINUE; fix SHARE continuation.

Review can finish without forcing
the student to write a summary.
Keep replies in the right context

Add future-week gates; separate
router instructions from guardrails.

Known-week requests can be gated;
internal prompts avoid misrouting.
slides.callout: Implemented in reviewed code. Live deployment, timing and complete student journeys still need verification.

Week 5 refinement, Week 6 exits and retries.

correct ending and observed delivery timing.

Use scenarios before and after
the journey to assess use of the four questions.

responses before interpreting any change.
